release.body:
These builds aren't signed yet, so the first launch needs one extra step:
- **macOS:** open `Pomme.app` with right-click → Open, or allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.
- **Windows:** on the SmartScreen prompt, choose More info → Run anyway.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x pomme-client-linux-x64-gnu.AppImage`, then run it.


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
* open the hopper, dispenser and dropper screens by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/866
* let the cursor go when the window loses focus, keep test windows off it by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/875
* fix missing chunks at high render distance by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/853
* render perf by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/872
* distant terrain by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/873
* Faster, responsive startup by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/876
* Drop unreachable boot screen fallbacks by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/877
* Footsteps and a generated block sound table by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/878
* Place, landing and splash sounds by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/879
* floor the player's position when finding its chunk column by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/856
* open the brewing stand and crafter screens by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/869
* lock each chunk column once per collision scan by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/894
* Tidy the install folder by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/895
* Close chat when the server opens a container by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/896
* fix third-person camera culling and player body rotation by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/885
* Show FPS through debug entries and Debug Options by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/883
* render item tooltips in containers and 3d player heads in menus by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/884
* render 3d nameplates for players and named mobs by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/886
* Bump pyronyx to 0.5.1 by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/897
* Load Vulkan at runtime and explain a renderer that can't start by @Purdze in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/887
* render sign text in world space and add sign edit screen by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/888
* render boat models, simulate steering, and handle passenger seating by @Sqrilizz in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/889
* draw multipart blocks by their full conditions: redstone wire, shelves and chiseled bookshelves by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/890
* split the protocol translator by version and pick its rewrites from dispatch tables by @Chromatischer in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/891

## New Contributors
* @Chromatischer made their first contribution in https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/pull/894

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PommeMC/Client/compare/client-v0.2.9+26.2...client-v0.2.10+26.2

commit.message:
feat(resources): Migrate resource consumers to ResourceManager system (#785)

* feat(resources): introduce resource configuration and providers

Introduce the byte/provider layer, resource configuration, registry and metadata APIs without changing decoding or wiring migration consumers. Temporarily allow dead_code and unused_imports only on the Resources module declaration; the dependent migration removes this allowance.

* refactor(resources): use extracted assets and setup-time pack validation

* refactor(resources): adopt Vanilla-style packs and repositories

Replace the obsolete Resources engine with pack backends, suppliers, repository sources, and reloadable managers.

Initialize resource views in AppCore and retain verified installer JARs for format metadata. Preserve the existing asset stack while consumer adoption remains deferred.

* feat(resources): migrate splash text and menu logo consumers

* refactor(resources): simplify fallback stack ownership

* refactor(resources): remove unused empty-manager argument

* test(resources): cover Vanilla-compatible public APIs

Add 211 API-focused resource tests with shared trait assertions and backend fixtures, including test-only supplier helpers and RAII cleanup.

Fix ZIP empty-directory listing parity discovered by the regression tests: construct the prefix as root + directory + slash, matching Vanilla even for an empty directory.

* test(resources): cover pack path containment

Add direct ResourceId::from_parts construction with private parsing helpers.

Add 15 black-box path_validation cases covering resource representability and pack path containment.

* build theme panorama paths with / so Windows themes load

* extract the jar's version.json instead of caching the jar, so existing installs start without a download

* refactor(audio): migrate playback to resource manager

Make selected resource content transferable through Arc suppliers and Send readers, with pinned ZIP generations and atomic close state.

Load the sound registry from the active resource manager and hand selected content to the audio worker for decoding. Invalidate cached buffers on resource activation while retaining incremental streaming without buffering full encoded audio.

Plumb borrowed resources through existing audio callers and update the resource contract documentation.

* refactor(resources): migrate remaining consumers and pack selection

Move remaining non-shader consumers to ResourceManager with typed and
constant resource IDs and resource-backed font, model, and texture reads.
Integrate local and server pack selection with the shared resource view,
separate application activation from UI catalog capabilities, and bootstrap
headless and benchmark consumers through resources.

Remove the legacy resource-pack manager and filesystem resolver. Preserve
the separate audio migration and the resource-system foundation beneath it.

* fix(resources): handle font and server pack reload failures

Propagate UI font loading failures and retain the existing font atlas when resource refresh fails.

Remove rejected server pack candidates and restore the exact previous same-UUID registration on activation failure.

* fix(resources): preflight UI fonts before resource activation

Prepare candidate UI fonts once before publishing the active resource view or replacing live world assets. Restore staged server pack pop/clear registrations and mappings when preparation fails; later consumer failures remain outside this rollback boundary.

* fix(resources): skip failing packs instead of failing reloads, match Identifier rules, drop dead code

- Lookups, listings, sources, themes and ZIP opens log and skip on error, so the embedded pack always loads and boot no longer retries forever
- Bad filters filter nothing; bad index hashes skip that entry; the vanilla pack exposes exactly minecraft and realms and is no longer fixed
- ResourceId orders path then namespace, takes lowercase paths only, refuses `..` namespaces and reads `:foo` as minecraft
- Duplicate pack names keep the later pack; pack formats read like Codec.INT; ZIP lookups use the hash probe
- allowed_symlinks.txt globs use a port of the JDK glob syntax, dropping the glob crate
- version.json is part of a finished install, so old installs re-download the jar once
- Remove blanket dead_code allows and the code nothing uses; items only #785 needs carry a per-item allow
- Tests for pack priority, filters, sidecars, failing packs and sources, catalog order, metadata formats and globs; shared test fixtures and one temp dir helper

* fix(resources): skip failing layers and entries, keep theme above vanilla, stop splash re-rolls

- Theme pack is required at the top edge, so a theme switch can't drop it below vanilla
- Reloads replace the splash list; a splash is picked only when the title screen opens without one
- Overlay layers, namespace entries and unreadable vanilla pack.mcmeta log and fall back instead of failing the pack
- pack.mcmeta skips a BOM and trailing content; splashes.txt decodes lossily and splits lines like BufferedReader
- An empty directory lists nothing in every backend
- Server pack downloads use packs::download; the old copy in resource_pack.rs is gone
- Resource::metadata is infallible and cached; ResourceOrigin drops the unread pack_id and names the pack by ID
- Shared helpers for root paths, prefix matches, pack.mcmeta reading, whole-content reads and the test pack
- Tests for theme reload order, stack sidecar pairing, filtered listings, failing overlays, metadata fallback, Gson-style parsing and symlink policy loading

* fix resource reload failures, translations and pack ordering

- Reload prep runs before activation, so a failed reload keeps the old
  view and never leaves chunk meshes cleared or the atlas destroyed
- Translations merge every namespace's en_us.json stack and reload with
  the pack selection
- Sounds resolve their file when sounds.json loads; a missing file drops
  only itself, and play calls no longer take the resource manager
- Theme packs expose only their panorama aliases, load once all six faces
  exist, and a theme switch refreshes only the panorama and menu sprites
- Server packs are required, pinned at the top, and stay out of the view
  when they fail to apply; pack toggles insert at their default edge
- Server pack hashes are used only when they are 40 hex digits
- Bedrock UI sprites resolve through lowercase aliases
- Sprite and font lookups treat a lookup error as absent
- Boot draws its first frame before the resource scans
- resource_pack harness option and ui/resource_pack_reload script

* keep old extractions installed, align pack names and aliases with vanilla, add resource tests

- An extraction from before version.json counts as installed; its pack format reads as unknown instead of forcing a jar download
- Manager entries are named by pack id; the namespace guard vanilla doesn't have is gone
- An alias to a directory is absent in lookups as in listings
- Tests for overlay priority, alias companions, sidecar filters and the splash loader
- self_cell loosened to 1.2; stale comments dropped

---------

Co-authored-by: Purdze <29306641+Purdze@users.noreply.github.com>

split the protocol translator by version and pick its rewrites from dispatch tables (#891)

* test(client): exhaustively compare native registry enums

Compare all ids and entry counts in every ClientRegistry against the runtime builtin enums.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5

* refactor(client): resolve game rewrites into dispatch tables

Select callbacks at table construction and validate every required packet name through all supported protocol constructors. The old-chain equivalence test passed all 1974 selections before removal. Retain packet-name and precedence checks.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* refactor(client): split translation rewrites by protocol

Move protocol rewrites, shared codecs, dispatch construction, inbound/outbound paths, and tests into translate/. Preserve function signatures and bodies apart from module visibility and formatting.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* refactor(protocol): generate entity serializer remaps by name

Extract registration order from SHA-1-verified Mojang jars and mappings with the protogen sibling tool. Generate all 15 embedded tables; remap by canonical serializer name and skip metadata through the native shape table. The temporary old-function comparison passed every id in 0..64 before deleting arithmetic remappers; retain those verified maps as a fixture. All tables reproduce byte-for-byte.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5

* refactor(client): own translation state per connection

Cache immutable translation tables in per-version OnceLocks. Give each connection its own dimension order and pending teleport acceptance, preserving state across reconfiguration and discarding it on reconnect. Add a regression that decodes logins across two successive connections and verifies the old dimension index is not retained.

Made with: OpenAI GPT 6.1 Sol

* Keep the particle drop at debug, restore the dimension-type TODO and add just serializergen

draw multipart blocks by their full conditions: redstone wire, shelves and chiseled bookshelves (#890)

* fix(client): evaluate multipart blockstate AND and OR selectors

parse_when_condition kept only string and bool values, so an AND or OR
selector became an empty map that matched every state: straight redstone
wire drew a dot, and shelves and chiseled bookshelves drew the parts for
every facing and fill state. Parse selectors into a condition tree with
alternatives, negation and nested AND/OR, and skip a malformed selector
with a warning instead of drawing it unconditionally.
tests/ingame/blocks/multipart_conditions shows all three blocks.

* Negate multipart terms one by one, reject empty terms and read combiners as the codec does
